charge_port.notes: Quick charge port (CHAdeMO) per the 2018 press kit. On the S it is optional (Quick Charge Package): a base S without it has only the J1772 AC port. Canada 2018 pricing release lists the quick charge port in standard equipment (trims not itemised; src-nissan-ca-leaf-2018-pricing).

supercharger_access.notes: Estimated: CHAdeMO port. Nissan's Dec 2024 Supercharger programme covers only the CCS Ariya; Electrek says the Leaf is excluded and uses CHAdeMO. No Nissan adapter exists for the Leaf.
